Alan Sparks illegally owned 88 fully-armed Cobra gunships — a $40 million fleet seized by the FBI. The investigation nearly caught Ron Garlick too, until officials discovered around two dozen Americans legally owned Cobra attack helicopters through a loophole in the military's demilitarization process. Here's how surplus attack helicopters ended up in civilian hands.
